review: Frank Green has an amazing customer service. They completely understand the customers perspective and very willing to assist. They are personal and will relate to you. title: I had left a 2 star review when I first…
review: I had left a 2 star review when I first received it because the bottle was scuffed upon arrival and although customer service was responsive, their process was cumbersome. They required that I sign up for an account before I could get to a page I was instructed to go to. I did not want to sign up. Luckily customer service over email was responsive, and I was offered a small discount for the faulty aesthetics. After 3 months of use, I am VERY HAPPY with the quality of the bottle. From previous reviews I notice that they seem to be quick to respond to feedbacks. For example, spouts are now sprung with a release, instead of having to be lifted up with your naked, and may often be dirty, fingers. While only a short time ago this was an issue, it is no longer an issue now. The quality of the build is exceptional. STANLEY CUP WHO. FRANK GREEN IS SO MUCH BETTER. Note that I am not trying to maintain a steady temperature of liquid in my bottle. Just room temperature spring water.

title: High build quality product
review: High build quality product. Clean, sleek design aesthetic. Water bottle is a good design. Tea / Coffee cup holds heat well, however the sipping hole could be re-designed with occasional drips left on the lid after sipping. Not the easiest to re-assemble parts after cleaning, however, the ability to do this for cleaning is a useful feature. The cleaning brush for the brass straw should be included with the bottle, particularly for the premium price. They are  expensive, and there is better value out there for drinking water and 'keep cups', however, its would be hard to find a better quality and sleeker designed product than Frank Green.

title: A great shame.
review: ordered the 10oz 295ml coffee travel mug in ocean blue. Arrived in good time. Seems to keep coffee hot for well over an hour. The sip hole in the lid works ok. And apart from one or two droplets, didnt seem to leak at all.  The finish of the outside cup is perfect, and very tactile but not slippy to hold.  Really nice.  Except....There is a distinctive gap between the underneath of  the lid, and the body of the cup.  Its just under tenth of an inch.  But very noticeable.  Especially when holding the mug.  Even with the top screwed down as tight as it will go.  Whilst the underneath of the lid isn`t really sharp, it does feel slightly abrasive. Obviously there is always going to be a line join, between lid and body of mug. But this does spoil the whole design which is such a shame.  As well as spoiling the user experience of actually holding and using the cup.  Maybe it is just I have got unlucky, and this applies just to this colour ocean blue .  I had planned on buying another, perhaps with an alternative colour  lid.  But I shall not consider this now.

title: 595ml Ceramic Reusable bottle
review: I bought a ceramic drink bottle in March. When it is working like a normal drink bottle, I enjoy it. However, having it seemingly magically spill over my bedding for the fiftieth time or more since buying it. I continue to have issues with it often spilling over my hands and bedding even though I’ve done the same thing and measured it as prior fills that have been acceptable. Note no clear instructions of all the magic spells and tricks needed for a seemingly innocuous drink bottle are provided on how to overcome this issue. Tonight I’m feeling fed up and I truly do hope this is simply an anomaly with my drink bottle not other peoples experience. Please ensure if you buy from this company you only buy it with it having the guarantee of working as appropriate (aka that assuming appropriate use, you will not end up with fluids everywhere). Have I contacted them? No. While their customer service before buying the bottle was pleasant to interact with predominantly, that does not assist when a product has issues of not working (and other times is fine). Instead, I’m leaving the review here instead and you can decide for yourself. Note: the straw was empty (learnt that early) but that means nothing, the dregs were drunk because hey learnt that one too and of course I do not overfill with the maximum ever put in as measured specifically at 530mls OR LESS for a 595ml bottle, do not try putting the larger advertised amount much in the bottle or you WILL make a mess. I’ve left this review so as an intelligent human, you can make up your mind and do your own investigations.

title: Frank Green has changed from what they’ve used to be.
review: I’ve been using Frank Green for years and loved them up until recently. One of the things I’ve loved about them is their mix and matching styles , the ease of switching and their commitment to making things right. I’ve not been buying much until this recent month where I bought their mystery box and obtained a bottle that was said to be straw lid friendly. So I used my old straw lid,  and it scratched the bottom base of the container. Apparently according to Frank Green it’s a different straw that looks exactly alike to another one. And that’s where I’ve realised the array of parts etc that is required and this mix matching styles no longer works I’ve asked for help to see if a recompense is reasonable but this declined. I wasn’t too upset by that, though that would have been nice, but rather disappointed about how they've moved as a company to different trends and styles that no longer fit their older items well. They’ve now become the problem they wish to solve that is an environment waste when kids and straws need to be purchased for specific bottles when in the past each base and lid would work. It disappointed me to see the company turn this way. I intend to use the product for as long as I can and the scratch on the base now just reminds me how this company has moved so far from what it used to be and what I supported.

Home. It’s one little word, packed with so much potential. We know that home doesn’t happen overnight. Just like you, home grows over time. And here at Oak Furnitureland, we’ve got what you need to grow it. 

Whether you’re putting down roots, or looking for a bigger space, we make furniture designed for life’s journey, with style that’s made to last. Because you don’t just furnish a home, you grow one.
  
How we do it
We can offer great prices because we have strong relationships with our suppliers. We work directly with them to get the best quality furniture at the best possible price.
We also have our own home delivery team. As delivery is completely under our control, we  deliver to our customers’ homes efficiently – if ordered from stock, within 7 days. Once delivered, our after sales care team can give support and advice on furniture care.
In the media
Oak Furnitureland has been named in the Sunday Times Fast Track list for six years running. This is an industry award for the UK’s best growing companies. In addition, our furniture is regularly featured in home style magazines.
All this means you can shop confidently with us. Browse our beautifully made furniture online, or visit one of our 100 stores. You’ll find great design for all kinds of home. And all our furniture is made for life.

review: POSITIVES:- Happy with our choice and the condition our furniture when it arrived. - Furniture was delivered as scheduled.NEGATIVES:- No advanced call on the day to say our  delivery was on its way.- Receiving a delivery at 9:45pm was late and not really conveinient. title: Terrible customer service
review: Everything about the service and furniture from the store was excellent but the delivery let them down three times. My elderly mother is very hard of hearing. We made sure that it was noted before delivery on every occasion. We were told each time that part of their delivery process is a phone call up to 30 minutes before which is fine as l can be there within 5 minutes. The first time they offered no explanation as to why they didn’t call. Fortunately a neighbour saw them and alerted Mum. She lives in a retirement apartment. The second time, a delivery time of between 7 and 10 pm which in itself isn’t ideal for an elderly person we were absolutely assured they would call beforehand, they didn’t so the delivery was missed. The third time I arrived as they were about to drive away. Three deliveries and no calls. After waiting 32 minutes to speak to someone after the second missed delivery who incidentally never called back having assured me she would and having all the delivery issues l would have to say l couldn’t recommend buying from them which is a shame as the products are excellent.

title: Quality is not as expected
review: Copenhagen chest of drawers -(living room)  Hmmm, it’s difficult to ‘star’, as the salesman was ok, the product looked fine in the showroom, but on its arrival the quality wasn’t as I expected . Perhaps, what I expect for a £480 oak piece of furniture to be these days, is too adventurous.The exterior of the piece looked ok, although the finish was ‘rough - needed another fine sand (the duster catches on the wood), the interior structure was not good. One piece of ‘structure’ wood, had a chunk missing and one bracket support, also had a chunk missing. Made in Vietnam, at a great rate ok knots I feel.Looks ok, but rough to the touch. In Oak Furniture’s defence, I had picked up the phone to complain, but put the phone down. Did I want all this hassle, re packing, waiting for collection, waiting for a another delivery and waiting to see if it’s of a similar standard. No i didn’t, as really the piece should have been checked before delivery. Just because you can’t see the damage and sub standard construction, doesn’t mean it’s acceptable. I’ve taken photos of the substandard internal wood, if  anyone wants to see.

Home. It’s one little word, packed with so much potential. We know that home doesn’t happen overnight. Just like you, home grows over time. And here at Oak Furnitureland, we’ve got what you need to grow it. 

Whether you’re putting down roots, or looking for a bigger space, we make furniture designed for life’s journey, with style that’s made to last. Because you don’t just furnish a home, you grow one.
  
How we do it
We can offer great prices because we have strong relationships with our suppliers. We work directly with them to get the best quality furniture at the best possible price.
We also have our own home delivery team. As delivery is completely under our control, we  deliver to our customers’ homes efficiently – if ordered from stock, within 7 days. Once delivered, our after sales care team can give support and advice on furniture care.
In the media
Oak Furnitureland has been named in the Sunday Times Fast Track list for six years running. This is an industry award for the UK’s best growing companies. In addition, our furniture is regularly featured in home style magazines.
All this means you can shop confidently with us. Browse our beautifully made furniture online, or visit one of our 100 stores. You’ll find great design for all kinds of home. And all our furniture is made for life.

title: Good service, poor rug!
review: Communications with CarpetVista were good and their service efficient but I am extremely unhappy with my rug. The colours are totally misrepresented in the website’s photographs, so much so, I thought I’d been sent the wrong rug but I hadn’t. The quality is poor too compared to similarly priced rugs from a different website. I am returning the rug.

title: Striped Runner

Initially it was over £100 reduced to £50+ therefore thought it must be quite 'substantial' / carpet like, however that was not the case - more like something I could have picked up for £20-£30 somewhere.Quite believe it is hand made an' all that, still expected far better quality. Moral of the story, as before, it it looks too good to be true - then it more than likely is. Be careful out there!

title: Poor communication and no follow-up to order
review: You are claiming you haven't received the funds I sent by bank transfer on December 24th, exactly TWO WEEKS AGO, and my Carpetvista account is still showing non-receipt of the funds. It does not take two weeks for funds to be received by bank transfer, so there must be some mistake on your side.Unfortunately I still have had NO RESPONSE to the emails I've been sending you, on 28th December and again on 3rd January, showing proof of the bank transfer. You now need to conduct a thorough investigation of this matter, as EUR 2,090 don't just go missing, and I have checked and checked again that no error was made during the bank transfer which I carried out myself. I am disappointed by your silence and lack of communication on this matter. It will not be solved until you start an investigation. My order number is 691786.I have never in my life had someone claim not to have received funds after this long delay. It is not possible for you not to have the money. It must be with you.If I don't hear back from you by the close of business today, I will cancel the order online. Note that in this case, you will still have to return the funds to me that I sent you.

title: The ‘installers’ are the weak spot
review: The ‘product’ we bought was good - a new walk in shower. Good quality products, nicely designed, a sympathetic ear to our desires. All good. Then they ‘introduce’ their installers. Nothing to do with Wickes, companies you’ve never heard of and, when you search them, complaint after complaint. Awful experiences with Wickes installations are the norm, there is no point providing a good product if you then use installers that no one would ever employ. To give an idea: our installation was pushed back one week (told on the day we were expecting them.) Took much longer than the 7 days quoted, yet a few days into the installation I had a call from Wickes, checking I was pleased with my new bathroom. ???  It was mostly still in our garage. Yet the ‘installer’ company had sent in a completion certificate with my signature forged! WTF? A quick mention about involving the Police for fraud and serious criminal behaviour seemed to work, they then completed the installation. A few issues but nothing serious but, to be honest, I would never use Wickes again. THEY are fine but they are utilising installation companies who are dubious, in my (and many others) opinion. If not dishonest - chatting with fellow customers on Facebook, it appears sending in the ‘completion’ certificate is widespread. As then they get paid and, frankly, will lose interest in completing the job. Come on Wickes - you and your customers deserve better. Why on Earth don’t you have your own installers? Then you would be a great bathroom / kitchen supplier.

title: Installation services attached to products are sub standard
review: It would be impossible to overstate my appalling experience with Wickes.Paid over £8000 for products and installation for a new bathroom (Nov 2023).3 days in WICKES fitter caused catastrophic flood through 3 floors of my 19th century cottage. His insurance was inadequate and left me over £1000 short of the claim. WICKES refused to cover my loss.Work was completed over 50% beyond the accepted date and the workmanship was poor, leaks established to toilet and shower but lack of remedial response. WICKES failed to respond to telephone calls and emails for some 6 weeks and until I wrote to the CEO regarding legal action (JAN 24).Remedial action was then agreed but not completed until MAY 2024. This was then unsatisfactory and agreed as such by WICKES. The company then conceded that the bathroom needed to be replaced. This was finally achieved OCT 2024. The level of disruption in the property, and where the bathroom is sited on the top floor via 2 narrow stairways has been difficult and generated decorative damage. WICKES have refused to pay for this. I have no other bathing facility so had to travel to my gym to shower, some 22 mile round journey. WICKES refused to pay for this.As a direct result of the flooding and disruption I have suffered from poor sleep, anxiety and low mood. WICKES have consistently disregarded my concerns and been poor to respond. I have never received a formal apology. My claim for compensation has been disregarded. The company’s offer of “goodwill” amounted to approx 92p per day over 11.5 months. I remain financially deficit for damage caused in the property both from flooding and wear and tear.I make no comment regarding WICKES products, however I would strongly advise against the installation service.

The desk depth is only 45cm which is on the thinner side, hence the issue with the monitor when leaning forward. Most people probably won't have this issue.I will leave initial comments below so that other uses can see my experience and the very mature and professional response from the Back in Action team to resolve the issues.-----------------The staff were helpful and answered questions, gave plenty of time but they weren't really honest about what buying a kneeling chair might mean for my current setup. I said I was WFH 40 hour weeks with existing desk and setup. I use big monitors and do CAD work so need careful control of the mouse.When I eventually built the Varier Variable Plus seat after stripping a screw (no spares for a £550 product - very poor. Bolts are not expensive just put an extra of each piece in just in case) I found it is much lower than my existing chair and so I am getting very tight and sore traps and shoulders because my elbows are too high at the desk. I have no way to adjust this except putting something under the chair which is another faff and will look awful. The kneeling action also pushes the head closer to the monitors so if you have a thin desk it is hard to use the different monitors and causes eye strain.So... back pain reduced but caused more problems elsewhere. Build quality and assembly quite poor for this price point - I would expect a smooth thought out process but several steps in the instructions were difficult to understand and carry out, and required additional tools (hammer and knife).

I was a bit nervous that I might have left it too late to have it for Christmas (I think it was the evening of 18th December) but it arrived at about 2.00p.m. on 20th.In order for an artificial tree to be more eco-friendly than a series of natural trees it has to last a minimum of 10 years, which is a big ask. Right away I realised that this was not the same quality (the fabric actually feels more like polycotton) but the price was good so I decided to keep it. But then I noticed how small the pillow cases were and measured them against what was shown online. One of them was 2.5cm smaller in width than advertised. I emailed customer service and was told that this was within guidelines. They also said they should be dried on low. I have a heat pump drier and it does not get hot. Though there is no “low” setting.  End of story I guess! A previous purchase of a Morris & Co set was amazing. So I am very disappointed this time.

review: I needed new mugs & had criteria:pretty set of 4 not crazy expensivenot made in ChinaSpent about 30 mins researching websites & various brands before settling on Belleek. Was charmed by description of their factory in Ireland. Found a pretty set on sale (but still more than I've ever paid for mugs), paid the additional $20 shipping fee. Told myself a splurge was okay for my mugs made in Ireland. Got them, the box has a sticker "Made in PRC". Sent email to Belleek asking them to be less deceptive in their product information, because Bellek's product description of these mugs, and Belleek's website never even hinted some of their wares weren't made in Ireland. Their email reply thanked me for my "feedback" and affirmed that yes, some of their line is "Made in PRC". I kept the mugs, they are pretty, & it would be a hassle to return, but I wouldn't have bought them if the product description listed "Made in China (PRC)" or "Imported", like the other brands I had researched. I'm just actively trying to decrease my reliance on the mass production of nearly every household good from China, & wanted to source from other geographical locations, and I do rely on informative and accurate product description to do so.

description: The UK's No. 1 Trade Kitchen Supplier.

description: The UK's No. 1 Trade Kitchen Supplier.

When I queried the estimate date I was told that means nothing and the 23rd was the final date. Unfortunately Magnet kitchens couldn't do the early January because of short notice, so I've ordered from Howdens. That's ok but It narks me that an estimate valid date is pointless, and I've had Issues with Howdens before with customers being somewhat forced into taking kitchens early to keep "an offer". That's my reasons why Howdens is no longer my 1st choice for kitchens.

description: The UK's No. 1 Trade Kitchen Supplier.
title: Uninterested Designer
review: This year I have helped an elderly relative with the insurance claim after a fire.   The main contractor allocated the kitchen re-fit to Howdens, Cobridge.   (Local to him, not us, but this is understandable.)I attended the house with my relative to meet Beth, our designer.   We indicated that the new kitchen should be a copy of the old.   As she measured up, she indicated various pages in the brochure for us to select work-tops, handles etc.   To my surprise she made little conversation and offered no suggestions.   We could view samples half a mile up the road at our local branch.   We did so, but the staff had little interest as presumably we were not "their job".Eventually the plans arrived.   As an experienced computer user it took me a few minutes to extract the .pdf.   Why not just attach the plans as a regular .pdf like everybody else?We quickly identified three areas that needed correcting and I emailed Beth.   She sent fresh plans which partly corrected some issues, but other items had been altered for no apparent reason.   This happened again ... and again.   I sent 3D drawings and explained what we wanted, but to no avail.   If she had been working directly for me, I would have terminated the job and gone elsewhere.However the main contractor was on a schedule so I suggested a meet with Beth.   She said this would be at her branch in Cobridge.   This was an unfamiliar area to me, the day after it had snowed and clearly not a journey I could undertake with an poorly elderly relative.   So my wife and I went.   We stood in the display area expecting to be seated in an office and offered coffee on such a miserable day.   My wife has a walking stick, so you could guess a seat may have been welcome.   Beth came out, noted our amendments and said she would email them back to us.    I insisted she go and enter it on the computer for us to check.   She left us standing in the display area, using a hob unit as a desk.   Sure enough, these plans created more issues.   Once more I insisted she make the amendments immediately.   We were offered use of the coffee machine which promptly squirted coffee into the grid and dispensed my wife half a mug of warm milk!After 2-3 weeks, we now learned that drawers didn’t come in the size we had been asking for and the sink we selected on the first meeting did not fit!   Eventually on what must have been our sixth attempt I signed off the plans.   If I had not made the effort to visit Cobridge I doubt we would ever have reached this stage.   Given that to most people a new kitchen would be a very expensive, luxury purchase, at no time were we made to feel special or even wanted as customers.Ironically I later spoke to the contractors’ own workman as he installed the kitchen.   “There was a lot of wasted space there, so I made the cupboard bigger for you”.   Just what I had been asking for but given up on!!

description:
Saxon Furniture Ltd, a family run, British company who have been expertly hand-crafting Chesterfield leather and fabric furniture for 40 years.
The success of the company can be attributed to the dedication and ethos of producing the finest Chesterfields and leather/fabric furniture in the country without exception. title: Very disappointed to have our order delayed
review: Very disappointed to have our order delayed by 2 months. If we had known at the outset how long our order would take (made in May, only just fulfilled despite being told we would have it in August), we wouldn't have gone with Sofas by Saxon. We also had lots of emails back and forth about delivery dates and delays, and felt the offer of a few scatter cushions (2 if we wanted them covered in the material we picked or 4 with a different backing) and £35 back when we had spent over 5K and been delayed by two months was very weak. We aren't overwhelmed by the finished product we received. The structure of the seated cushions on one sofa is much less firm than the one we tried in the shop. The way the fabric has been laid on the second fabric doesn't fully work with the pattern. All in all, a disappointment and would not recommend.Edited to respond:I haven't emailed back yet because I have been recovering from surgery. I feel it's important to correct your facts below as my review has been honest and in good faith. The initial date provided when we made the order was the end of August. It was a long while later you suggested 12th September as a delivery date, which we couldn't make. When we said this, we were actually first offered a delivery date a couple of weeks after the 21st September. It's only when we pushed back that we were offered the 21st.I'd have been happy with a refund of £405 but as you say, I was offered scatter cushions and £35 (I had to argue for this as initially you only offered the delivery charge or cushions). Yes you retail 4 scatter cushions at £370, but it doesn't cost you that to make them and I didn't want to buy them, so I wouldn't say the value of your compensation is £405. As the adage goes, something is only worth what someone is willing to pay, and I wouldn't pay £370 for 4 cushions. I would have been happy with a refund to that amount as I told your after sales manager when we spoke, but this was not offered. Instead I've got cushions I would never have bought.I hope you can resolve the issues I've highlighted for future customers, and you are able to take on the feedback from customers. Genuine compensation should be something the customer wants, not something that costs you little to give away.

title: We used this company after reading all…
review: We used this company after reading all the fantastic reviews and the fact they are British made.  Sadly our experience has not been amazing.    Yes the sofas look great - we had three large leather ones and two footstools but that’s where the quality ends.   We had to send ours back as the sewing and craftsmanship on the cushions was awful - seams didn’t line up and the cushion insets didn’t fit the leather properly and over hung.  They did come and pick them up and undertook to make good.   They got returned last week and whilst the fit is better, it is not really what you would expect for sofas in this price bracket (we have Natuzzi in other room and far better).   The have put anti slip mats under each cushion to stop them sliding forward when seated - thankfully you can’t see it but it’s just loose and not really craftsman like!! So whilst we’re not totally unhappy - would we use again - no.  Nobody has followed up to see if we are happy which I would have thought should have happened but hey ho.

title: Could have done a lot better

title: Adequate, but not as good as they used to be!
review: This review is of our third sofa suite (a Boston) brought from Saxon just under two years ago. Unfortunately the sofa has developed a fault, possibly due to the chassis collapsing. We contacted Saxon and after initially informing us the sofa was outside their 12 month guarantee period, they did agree to look at it, however we got the impression that they were going through the motions of customer service, rather than aiming to exceed our expectations which was very much our experience previously, our two previous sofas are still going strong with no faults. The sofa collection/inspection was very much at their convenience rather than ours. In the end we have cut our losses and will replace the sofa with another from elsewhere. It may be due to new ownership or maybe just the realities of commercial pressures, but whereas our previous sofas which we still have were much better than tej competition and justified the cost premium, I am afraid our last sofa is as good as, but probably not better, than the competition and probably not worth paying a premium. A real shame!Update:Dear Mr DeightonI believe we gave a fair and proportionate review of our last suite from Saxon, we didn’t say it was poor, just in our opinion, not as good as our previous purchases, and no longer worth paying a premium, and we surmised why this might be the case.I would say if you put as much effort into helping to resolve customer issues as you have put into your long response after we left this review, we probably wouldn’t have had an issue. I reported the problem to your company almost 2 months before putting pen to paper and I consider that ample time for you to have dealt with the matter, even in these COVID times.

title: MFI customer service
review: We ordered a rocking chair from saxon in August. We chose mahagony and red leather. The chair was to compliment our bedroom and we could not wait to pick it up. The chair cost £695. We decided to pick up the chair ourselves as we were paying a visit to Lancashire that October weekend.We arrived at saxon and were told to drive to the pick up point at the back of the showroom. We rang the bell the door came up and the chair was bundled into our vehicle. We thought we would try and check to see if it was correct. When we peeled back some of the bubble wrap it revealed what seemed to be deep scratches along the length of both rails.We returned to the showroom to ask someone to inspect the chair. We think the workshop manager came out and we took the chair into the showroom. On inspection we were informed that it was the grey paint from the workshop floor. After some discussion it was suggested that the chair be re polished and we were to collect in one hour.On our return to the showroom the chair was sat by the door nobody greeted us no one to apologise or explain. We carried the chair out to our vehicle ourselves. We felt the whole episode had been dealt with very badly, customer service non existent. The fact that no one had let us inspect the chair before we took delivery, no apology no customer service at all. We were very glad that we found this problem before leaving saxon as we live in Solihull. We have purchased many pieces of furniture  from saxon in the past so you can imagine our disappointment at this level of service. We do love the chair and it looks lovely in our setting. It is such a shame that we were made to feel like we were a nuisance.

title: A Mixed Experience
review: I have purchased a variety of furniture from Dunelm in the last few months - two beds, two mattresses, chair, sofa, footstools. Also some accessories and bedding.I generally found the furniture to be OK, though in some cases I am slightly worried about the durability of the items - things such as the quality of wood in one of the beds and the way the feet don't always seem to screw on straight when assembling the chairs and sofa.They are, in modern terms, cheap pieces of furniture, so you can't expect top quality. One of the beds we bought was quite shoddy, with poor finish and some poor wood, but we needed it in a hurry and it was just about acceptable. It is going to be a guest bed so it shouldn't be a problem.The main problem I had was delivery. Beds and chairs come by Dunelm and are delivered by helpful professionals. Footstools come by a third party service - less efficient, less helpful and, worst of all, not coordinated with the other deliveries. Ordering furniture for a new house that was two hours away is a real pain having to coordinate these things.Then there are the accessories - they won't deliver pillows, sheets or mattress protectors at all, so you have to make a special trip to the shop to buy these.When you raise this in a Dunelm review they refuse to publish the review.However, after buying a chair and a sofa that were smaller than expected, and a poor quality bed, I would recommend seeing them in the shop anyway. OK.To sum up - the quality of most of the furniture was OK and is reasonable value. The delivery system is a bit of a mess, though the Dunelm delivery men and customer services people are very good. And, after using two other similar companies recently I have to say that Dunelm is the only one I would be happy to use again.

Ideally you would benefit from having 4 people to help position it on completion.

title: Sleepland Beds gave me a great experience
review: Sleepland Beds gave me a great experience ordering. When needing to exchange before delivery, that was also smooth over the phone. Staff was really helpful and even video called me so I can see the bunkbed in their warehouse. Delivery was within the week and assembling with my husband took a day. At one point hubs crashed out and me and the children finished the assembles. Only thing is when screwing in the bolts/screws, do not use a drill because all you need is a screw driver and it also comes with a screw winder. Easy to assemble as long as you follow step by step and not rush. We did something wrong and had to undo to fit into the right way round but thats ok, had a break and went back to it. Another important point, we thought we was missing a part for the draws (G) and searched and hunted the whole place and packaging. This silly part appeared from nowhere when we had almost finished assembling. They should have put it with the draw or the screws packaging because now I'll have to go back to the instructions and add the missing parts so the draws so they can work properly.The bunk is my height which mean it'll last long for my 10 and 6 year old. Has lots of storage space and doesn't take alot of room. My bunk is Platinum bunk with storage in White. So far I am happy with the product and service received.

title: A bit of a bumpy ride, but worth it.
review: tl;dr Bed is sturdy and looks good (worth enduring the negatives I'm going to discuss, admittedly), delivery was no-hassle, instructions difficult, staff are very passionate about their company and are helpful, the Pay In Three option is fantastic, but my overall experience was ultimately just "okay" which I'll go into detail about below if you're interested.I opted for this company over one other I was thinking about, even though Sleepland Beds were the more expensive option. I was worried if I bought something cheaper it would be less safe/sturdy, and this site not only had glowing reviews, it allowed me to pay via Paypal's Pay in Three scheme which ultimately swayed me. This was a huge purchase for me and something I researched well before committing.I chose the Supersonic Double Bunk Beds with Drawers (Triple Sleeper) in white.Delivery was smooth and seamless, and the driver was friendly enough. He took all of the pieces up to the room I needed them to be in which was amazing as I would not have been able to do that myself. Do beware delays, however, which are dependent on where you live. Make sure to read to the very, very bottom of the Delivery page on the website or you might miss this detail (as I did).The bed is attractive-looking and also very sturdy and safe. The ladders hold my adult weight for changing the sheets so I'm not worried about the kids climbing up and down. However, the workmanship could be better. The white paint scuffs easily - it was scuffed in places when I unpackaged everything, and then building it has added more scuffs. The slats for the top single bed had exposed staples too - it's clear someone stapled in the wrong area, was unable to remove the staples, and so just... left them there, which isn't great (I had to remove them myself with some difficulty).I did also have a couple of issues with the instructions. In the first instance, I was upset with the response from the customer service representative when I raised an issue about one particular component not matching the image in the instructions. There was an attempt made to help me understand the instructions better but in my opinion, the instructions should be clear enough that there doesn't need to be elaboration. In the second instance, it was discovered that the instructions delivered with my bed were incorrect and Sleepland Beds did send me the older, correct version via email so I could complete the build. I do believe the company is going to amend this issue for anyone who might be worried though.All that said, I'm not a novice with building furniture. I've worked in furniture stores and built all manners of flatpack for personal use at home (not just IKEA), and I really do think the instructions are unnecessarily confusing for this bed. They are difficult to follow - not accessible in the least. Something to bear in mind if, like me, you will be tackling this project alone. You may need to pay or ask someone you know to help.Customer service is acceptable and to Sleepland Beds' credit, they do go out of their way to fix problems and help where they can. At this point though I am starting to feel a little harassed ha ha, and I hope this will be the last edit I have to make to my review.My experience remains three out of five stars because when purchasing flatpack furniture, I do expect to be able to build the item without having to query the instructions, and this purchase hasn't been without issues. However, to anyone reading this, I wouldn't deter you from ordering. Especially in these times, being able to pay in instalments for something essential like this is a huge help and I feel confident that this bed is safe and will last a good while. Sleepland Beds are a trustworthy company. But I would suggest you are mindful that the build is going to be way more difficult than you probably expect (and to prepare accordingly), and you may end up waiting for it, so definitely order in advance of when you actually need your furniture.I hope this review has been useful.

title: Frustrating - Thomas light oak bunk beds
review: If my husband had not been a proficient at woodworking, he would have found it virtually impossible to assemble the bunk beds - lovely though they are.  Instructions were non-existent, apart from a few diagrams. Screw holes were barely big enough, and in most cases he enlarged them with a drill.  One had not been properly countersunk and unfortunately, this was the one he happened to start with.  The allen key provided was barely adequate for the job, and in fact, he was sent a replacement.  He has so far only assembled one of the bunks, and it looks as if the screw holes for the ladder are not quite lined up.  I would not recommend this product to an inexperienced amateur, but I think the finished product will be beautiful.

title: Tricky to build but good, strong bunk beds
review: This is for Thomas Deluxe Pine Bunk Beds and Drawers. Delivery was great - spot on in fact. And the bunk beds, now they are up, are fine. They seem sturdy enough and look pretty good. The drawers are great and hidden by end panels - the main reason I chose them.  But building them was hard going! Some of the holes were in the wrong place, some of the bolts didn't fit, quite a few of the holes were drilled at angles rather than straight and some of the screw threads were stripped. And the bolts that hold the main bits together were a real fiddle to get to work!!! All in all - putting it up took 2 of us around 4 hours, some manipulating of the parts, a lot of brute strength and good power tools. I'd have given them 4 stars, because really, the bunk beds are fine and  strong. But every time I look at them I remember the torture of putting them up. And according to this, 3 stars means -  average, acceptable experience but with some friction. Which is about right.

title: Terrible quality and very unhelpful when I wanted to return the item
review: We received the bed quickly and the delivery was great.  However when we started putting the bed together we were very disappointed with the quality and the finish.  I spoke to customer services who told me it would cost me £80 to return (not the maximum £40 they claim on the website). They then said it had to be returned in its original packaging which was a problem as I had broken up the polystyrene as I went along to give me more room.  I asked if I could bubble wrap it and send it back but they said I would have to pay to send it back myself (from Devon to Chester).  They said they would then assemble it and refund me if all was ok.  I started packing it up but noticed some of the pieces were chipped or the laminate was coming away on some of the items I hadn't even put together.  As I hadn't mentioned this when I phoned because I hadn't noticed it, I thought they wouldn't believe me.  I really couldn't afford to take the risk of paying to send it back and not getting refunded.  I have never written a bad review for anything before but having had such a terrible experience and being left with a bed I don't want I felt I needed to write one about Sleepland beds expressing how disappointed and frustrated I am.

review: Maidstone store were brilliant , Danielle our designer was great , she listened to what we wanted and made better suggestions, answered any queries we had and always replied to emails.  The delivery drivers were good.  Customer service not very good, some were helpful , we had issue with warped doors , fitter advised the need to be replaced, customer service agent was difficult and rude , he said how do we know they need replacing ?  I asked to speak with a manager and was refused,  then told send the photos of warped doors ,need to be emailed  by 4pm in order to get the replacements on same delivery of other replacement items, photos sent in morning no reply emailed 3 times no reply , then on Monday I phoned 3 days later and asked for manager this customer service man was helpful, and sorted straight away,   I had raised a complaint of which a manager phoned me and said they have 24 hours to reply , I explained this has passed and the previous agent had not advised of this timescale and stated had to be there by 4pm ,  she said she listen to the call,  never heard from her again and just got an emails saying case closed.Our kitchen is beautifully fitted and looks very nice,It’s a shame customer services have some unnecessary difficult staff

review: Having just had our Kitchen installed, I would just like to say from start to finish everything was perfect.Some negative reviews,but from my experience don’t listen to them.From choosing our kitchen,in a wonderful showroom,to the expertise of the sales person,to the delivery (polite and punctual),and fitters were fantastic and very knowledgeable,Thank you Wren.

title: Great service
review: We had some issues with our first planner never being available but once we changed to our new one it was all very good. Planned and changes made easy. Regular calls with any price changes or savings. Delivery was smooth, all units packaged very well. Delivery team very professional and polite. No issues with fitting we had our own fitter. Nothing missing and all fitted very well. Now just to remove all protective coverings and enjoy our lovely new kitchen.

title: The kitchen My house deserved
review: There were some real issues with my kitchen in its Original fitted state. the product itself is a great quality and has a  robust feel to it, Unfortunately it lacked the finesse I thought I was getting from having Wren Fit it.I would have given this review a 2 star rating or less. if it was not for the member of staff that I was lucky enough, to talk to in after sales. I wont, put her name here or I believe she would be over run with request, but wren take note she saved the day and should be used as a role model. Every one can forgive things that go wrong as this is the real world. It's how they react to them, that maters. I am sorry to say it took the best part of 3 months to get some one to take ownership of the problem. But once she did it has all been completed to what I must say is  a very high standard, and all problems have been corrected, to a mutually agreed end result.one thing outstanding is the rubbish removal, but believe now I have spoken to the member of staff I trust, just back from leave that will be completed tomorrow.  I write this now as I can trust her word and  I know she follows up on what is agreed, and if need be I can EDIT this. My advice, Wren kitchens sell a great product, get what you want and just watch how the installation is going, and if the need arrises get a relationship with a great after sales representative. and you will know, if they truly are helping you very quickly.

review: Fitted a Wren kitchen for my daughter.Quality of units was ok. Wickes carcasses were stronger..Wren use a 9mm loose particle board for the backing. Not good.The design had a huge flaw. The tower units were 2m high. The ceiling height is 2.7m leaving a very weird looking space above the units. The designer didn't give the option of taller units so my daughter didn't know there were different heights. Wren showroom wouldn't even speak to them about it... told them to speak to head office but advised that Head Office wouldn't help. Asked about dark green edging tape for the grey carcasses... they don't do edging tape.I could have got the kitchen at half the price elsewhere.

We were informed that both rooms would be fitted one after the other only to be told this would now happen 10days later. In the meantime received an irate phone call from one of wrens employees stating he was going to report his colleague. Contacted "customer care" about our complaint who said they couldn't do nothing about it. Explained I was in the middle of Chemotherapy treatment amongst other things but they refused to change. Highly disappointed!

review: There were quite a few issues with wrong parts, wrong colour parts etc.  And athough these were resolved in a reasonable time span it has left us out of pocket as we have had to pay our fitter to work more days than planned/budgeted for and he will still have to return to complete fitting our kitchen when the right parts do eventually arrive.

title: Don't accept first price!
review: Excellent customer service and clear dates for delivery. Down side is pricing. Initial price was reduced after a couple of days by 2/3000 pounds. Free work tops and cheap appliances also don't exist unless you pay the top price so it's just cost shunting. Do your sims and walk away. Theu will find another deal for the exact kitchen and reduced fitting costs. Get you're own fitter. Even at lower price their fitting is extortionate.All said my kitchen is now fitted and looks great.

title: Stay away from dark coloured units with a Matt finish
review: We bought a Matt navy blue kitchen from Wren which was delivered in December 2022. The ordering process was a pleasure and the customer service team easily and willingly helped with any issues that we had. The kitchen looked gorgeous when first fitted but that is no longer the case. The finish on the cupboards appears to be absorbent and we have so many marks that we simply cannot remove. The most annoying of these are fingerprints from opening and closing the cupboards and doors and water marks down the doors underneath the sink. Wren have been totally unhelpful and have not offered any solution. Online forums have suggested, amongst other things, window cleaner, vinegar and baking soda, none of which have helped. The kitchen still looks fabulous in the evening but as soon as there is any natural sunlight it looks dreadful. We have made a very expensive error!

review: Kitchens look great in the showroom, but found that once they had your money it's not so good. Promised a Friday delivery date, got a Tuesday one. Now a few weeks after install; drawer front has come off in my hands, integrated dishwasher broke...

title: Nice kitchen poor follow up support service!
review: Wren kitchens have a good planning design service. Fundamentally the fitting process was fine although one unit was sent wrong size! This was rectified quickly by me buying a couple of shelves from a DIY store as waiting for the correct one from Wren would have delayed the finishing of the kitchen by some weeks. However its the after care service that is poor. A faulty tap and minor water leak was reported shortly after the kitchen was finished in February. After numerous emails and calls it finally got fixed yesterday April 23rd!!Something to be mindful of!

title: The units look good the kitchen wasn’t…
review: The units look good the kitchen wasn’t redesigned just needed updating. Unfortunately it took far too long 16 days without a kitchen the Wren fitter was away with other jobs in between ours. We asked for a breakdown of fitting prices and were shocked it cost more to fit than the actual item price. We weren’t impressed with the amount of worktops over and side units obviously over measured. The customer service is poor we have paid another plumber to redo a job and someone else to finish the flooring. The main thing is to get a good fitter, my sister recommended Wren her fitter was excellent.

review: Design was excellent but using the fitter left us with nice units but exposed pipes and cables, no tiling, bare walls and units that needed cleaning. Fitter charged for what they could do - excellent ceiling, lighting and plastering, but because workman did not turn up they have had to walk away having run out of time. Our hope had been that 6 weeks after units were delivered we would just need to decorate to finish, however, we have been left running around trying to find people who can complete the work.Conclusion 1. Get your own builder. 2 if you use Wren fitters expect to be in chaos for a minimum of 3 months whilst you go looking for your own builder to finish off

review: Just an observation that I was told by a Wren salesman that they require full payment one month prior to fitting.  So this means they expect their customers to finance their business.  Example, a £20,000 kitchen at current savings rates of say 5%. The customer could earn about £80 in interest during that month.

review: The aftercare has not been to an acceptable level.  Reordered cupboard was never ordered.  Intially ordered on 8th May - not arriving till 1st June.   Fitter due back on the Monday changes last minute to the Tuesday because the PO was incorrect. Ask for replacement item NOT to be delivered on 2 specific dates - it was.  We have had to take 3 additional days off work unnecessarily and had to move out painter and flooring company twice. Not a post fit happy customer at all.

title: Missing a length of pelmet
review: I thought the kitchen designer eventually understood what we wanted.   But there was a late change in the design that I wasn't aware of and I'm now short of one piece of pelmet.  Seems really challenging to get the extra bit; its now over a fortnight since I asked for it and I've no idea whether Wren understand that I want it and whether they are prepared to allow me to have it.  I need it to finish the kitchen.

title: Pushy sales and poor customer service
review: I booked a free ‘design’ appointment online at the Leicester store, I explained during the pre-appointment call that I wouldn’t be purchasing straight away and instead wanted to view the ranges within my budget and see how it would be designed. On arrival, the sales pitch started saying the appointment is ‘pointless’ if I’m not ready to purchase today. The salesman said he can price up a kitchen but didn’t see the point in designing the layout or required cabinets. His approach was pushy followed by dismissive. When I am ready to purchase I certainly won’t be using Wren based on their customer service.

title: Design experience Excellent

Go to Magnet for a longer lasting kitchen.

title: Avoid as they have terrible customer…
review: Avoid as they have terrible customer aftercare. They won’t return my calls and I keep getting fobbed off. We went to them for a full kitchen to be fitted. Fitter never came back to finish putting on some edging. Kitchen isn’t fitted to the plan so now my fridge door won’t open fully so I’m unable to take the shelves out of my fridge. All the cupboard doors have dropped and nothing lines up. Our extractor fan is filling the cupboard with condensation every time we use it and our cutlery draw under the hob does the same. The last time I spoke to them they said to take it up with the fitter. He won’t answer my calls or get back to me either. They supplied the fitter so should take responsibility for the fit which they are not! I have limited time to try and contact them as I work full time and the office hours are 9-5:30 Mon-Fri when I am at work. On the few occasions I have managed to speak to someone they have said that someone would call me back! This hasn’t happened. When my mum has tried to help all they say is that they can’t discuss it with her although it’s her house it was fitted in though I bought it. It’s a complete shambles. I want someone from Wren to come to my house and look at the kitchen to see if they think that it is fitted to the standards they expect! If so I would disagree that they are the UKs No1 affordable luxury kitchen. I paid them nearly £16000 for a kitchen which is far from luxury!

Unfortunately one of the unit doors has delaminated, but as it was spare, it didn’t matter, but gives cause for concern.I was charged for an upstand to my quarts worktops, which wasn’t asked for nor wanted, which meant another call to customer service, to which I’ve had to chase and I’m still awaiting the refund. All the problems were, in my opinion, initiated by the designer.

title: WARRANTY - BEWARE!
review: 10 Year WARRANTY - BEWARE. Two drawer fronts failed immediately below oven. Warped & laminate coming away. Kitchen designed by Wren!! Contacted Wren branch - ‘we only handle sales’ . Contacted wren Customer Care by email. They requested various photos. Received phone call…. Implied agreement to send replacement. Then followed by an email …on inspection of photos ‘moisture exposure’ & warranty does not apply! Also warranty not transferable!!! Disputed all - as designed by Wren it is a kitchen with heat/moisture - selected by the only occupier / owner of the property. As I was project manager/contractor for the barn conversion - I bought the kitchen and recovered money from the owner. - that deemed ‘change of owner’ to the screen watchers in Customer Care - ‘as account was in my name!! Eventually, several emails/telephone calls later - they agreed to send close ‘replacement’ (not the same - as line discontinued!!!!)  as gesture of goodwill!!! These were only 2 drawer fronts in a big kitchen!!! The experience with Customer Care was exasperating - feeling of them attempting to cop out replacement/warranty. You expect better from Wren who make such big claims about their leading status in the industry!! Recommended Wren to many in the past - but no more!

OMG they couldn't even replace the sink stopper which fell to pieces, we eventually bought one in B&Q. Every thing went really well up to installation. He was haphazrd, unreliable and damaged a lot, this includes the blinds in our conservatory where the parts were stored and chips to the existing kitchen floor tiles. I notice on the pictures and videos on their websiteshow lovely big kitchens, ours was small so probably didn't matter so much.I would never advise anybody to buy a kitchen from Wren. The interest free offer is a big attraction, pay the interest and get a loan from your bank, shop around, you will be amazed at the cost.The sales lady was brilliant.

description:
We are a family-run company specialising in home and garden products that are sold online via mail order. Feedback in any way is extremely important to us so we can continue to grow and ensure we are providing the best possible customer experience and service to our customers. 

We are a small, but ever-expanding and evolving business based in Central Scotland. Utilising online sales through our two brands, Garden Mile and Marco Paul, we provide a wide variety of beautifully crafted products for both home and garden, selling everything you could wish to maintain and beautify your indoor and outdoor space.

You will find inspiration for all environments, occasions and surroundings on our website. On our inspiration section you will find all the latest ideas, trends, hints and tips.

We are proud of our unique range of products that are majority designed by us and only us. We have a specialised customer service team who are on hand to help with any queries or questions you may have and to help guide you to ordering the correct products you require. 

We have been doing what we love for over 10 years now and are proud of how much we have achieved in this time. We take pride in our reputation and the continued relationships which are developing and growing with clients near and far.
title: Sincere and Responsible Seller
review: I was genuinely worried about losing out on Secret Santa Day because of a frustrating experience with another seller. Just when I thought all hope was lost, I discovered Marco Paul. I reached out to them, sharing my predicament and how the situation was threatening to spoil my Secret Santa celebration. To my relief, they stepped in and arranged the fastest delivery possible. In the end, I was able to present my Secret Santa gift to my colleague, and I was overjoyed when my gift was voted the best among everyone’s contributions. It truly felt like a small miracle that turned my day around!

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Great worktops
review: Great service from point of order to very speedy delivery, plenty of communication with delivery team. I’ve now fitted the worktops and very happy with the results, my only slight concern is that the laminate is extremely thin so not sure how durable it will be, only time will tell otherwise I would have give five stars, that said, I did have some of the cheaper worktops so that’s on me.All in all very happy customer would definitely recommend

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: The sales and delivery ecoeruencevwas…
review: The sales and delivery ecoeruencevwas great. The staff helpful and knowledgeable. The wokyops are hood bug ghe cutscwereca bit rough. The dounkedided tape did not the end stip yobthe worktop and zi hafvto use glue.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: The wood was cut to the size required
review: The wood was cut to the size required. Delivered as stated. The delivery men were friendly and carried it into the kitchen. The wood looks lovely. Only minor negative - it's not as smooth as I imagined.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Cost effective and delivered well but I…
review: Cost effective and delivered well but I would have thought it sensible to put some extra padding around the ends of the pieces when in transit.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Everything was wonderful and the…
review: Everything was wonderful and the product excellent until delivery. As a 77 year old man living on the 4th floor of a block of flats with a lift I would have liked to have had the product delivered at least to my door. A 2.0m long timber worktop is extremely heavy an awkward for a man of my age to manoeuvre.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Every aspect of my first time customer…
review: Every aspect of my first time customer exoerience was super. My only negative is !  My worktop arrived with some marks to the dark stain. Overal a good service.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Good advice at the workshop.
review: Good advices during our visit at the workshop.Delivery organisation can be improved. I didn't appreciate the way we can modify the date and who we communicate with the back office by email. Not possible to change the delivery date with an extra fee of £25 has not been appreciated.Product is good quality and conform to the expectations. Good finish.Plastic sticker on the worktop is difficult to remove. You could find a better quality of stickers for the future.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Excellent communication and service
review: Excellent communication and service - delivery went smoothly and products were very well packaged - However... whoever checked the 3m item (one of 4) should have noticed a chip on the  worktop !  Luckily it was at the back of the unit where it can be mostly covered with the splashback tile so no need to make a drama out of a chip !!  Excellent quality and very pleased with the colour and finish

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: The product was what I expected however…
review: The product was what I expected however it was 3 metres long 120 mm high and 18 mm thick making it very flexible, each was tightly shrink wrap and because of the above there was an obvious bias to each only evident when unwrapped. Bad luck for me as the bend, when placed against the wall was outwards and as I was sticking it a couple of very heavy toolboxes, one at each end came in very handy. End result looks good though. Word of warning, if buying with raw ends both have to be prepared as the veneer is 3-4 mm short at each end.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Delivery lets you down.
review: Easy to order, good lead time. Only downside was delivery men. Very straightforward delivery into hallway no steps etc but as involved a turn into front door refused and left outside. Once gone myself and my wife picked them up and walked them straight in. Sorry but was nothing but laziness on their part.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Beech worktop
review: Most of the experience was excellent. Design came exactly as I wanted. Process and delivery was quick and easy. The oiled finish was not great, however; there were various places where it had not been smoothed off afterwards.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Kitchen renovation
review: Everything was great, ordering simple, delivery efficient, 2 operatives to ensure worktops were in good condition.1 upstand laminate coating flaking a little but managed to cut it out.All in all no problem and would recommend this company.  Thank you.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Solid oak worktop, beautiful but warped wood
review: I’ve ordered from worktop express before and found everything to be great. However, this time I ordered a solid oak worktop - 3m & 4m length and both were warped. Thankfully my carpenter was able to work with it and clamp sections to help the wood straighten, but naturally this was extra labour time and hassle for him and so extra cost for us. We also got pre-oiled oak but I would say it isn’t worth the extra as it’s already taken another 3 coats of oil. The delivery service was top notch however and the delivery guys were great.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Black Stained Oak Worktop
review: Bought the new Black stained oak worktop, quality of wood is high as always. Staining was not great and  required a couple of sanding backs due to rough texture and then re-staining. Next time will buy unstained and stain myself. Delivery top notch as ever.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Trying to remove the stickers…
review: Worktops were delivered on time and contacted regularly. After installation 2 of the worktops had a sticker on face of them, I thought these would be low tack, how wrong was I, after phoning the seller to ask what could be used to remove the sticky glue remains we were told to get 100% acetone, we shouldn’t have to do this on worktops that have cost £1000

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Took 4 phone calls to get samples sent…
review: Took 4 phone calls to get samples sent out. Once ordered, delivery was fast. Delivery crew very polite and clear.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Check product is as ordered
review: Worktops were delivered as projected and delivery crew were very obliging.However, when fitter came to fit the worktops he noted they had bullnose edges not flat edges as ordered.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Average quality - poor delivery service
review: I’m sorry to say that the products arrived looking like they’d come off the back of a skip.  The limited plastic covering was ripped and the edges scuffed.  The delivery drivers said they’d take it back or I could ‘sand it’.  As I needed the worktop to complete my project, I took them and made the best of a bad job.  Also, the delivery was to ground floor only so I had to take them up the stairs myself which was super annoying!

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Slightly disappointed
review: Used before and no issues but this time the tops seem to have a few defects . The wrapping was ripped which would appear to have allowed the breakfast bar to cup. The worktop surfaces have scabs and raised areas as if delaminated ( solid oak so no sure what that is ) . Unfortunately I haven’t the time to return so have had to accept the condition of them and do my best to flatten and hide the marks .

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Damaged edges on delivery.
review: Both the surface and the splashback arrived with damage to edges. Fortunately the joiner was able to cut the work surface and splashback so that the damaged edges were not used but the items should not have been delivered damaged. The actual work surface and splash back looks good and is of reasonable quality it’s just disappointing that it was delivered damaged

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: I ordered two different lengths of…
review: I ordered two different lengths of bamboo worktop. After oiling one had white marks all over. So contacted, and it was very swiftly replaced. Which was fantastic. We received another length, and oiled with the same oil. There’s a huge colour difference to the other piece we already had, which was from the first order. So now we have an L shaped kitchen, with two very different contrasting sections of worktop. Which doesn’t look great at all. Quite disappointed with the outcome. And as we had cut it after oiling, I don’t think that they’ll replace it. As they only replaced the first length we had to send back, as it hadn’t been cut. Be careful when ordering as seem to be very big grain and colour differences between lengths.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Double check your standard 40mm Oak worktops.
review: Great company for ease of ordering. The delivery guys are lovely, courteous and very helpful. I purchased 3 x 3m lenghts of standard Oak worktop 40mm thick and 3 x 3m lengths of Oak upstand as I wanted the natural imperfections that make wood so elegant. You do not get this with the prime oak. However, on inspection there were a few knots and other parts of the wood that had not been sealed and finished, despite being assured that they would be. Fortunately I am decent with wood and rectified these myself with worktop sanding dust and mid brown starbond before re finish sanding myself. Others may not be so fortunate. Other than that, they are great. So 2 tins of Osmo Top oil later and very lightly sanded between coats they look very nice and warm.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Mixed emotions - too much faffing around
review: Liked the website at first and then disappointed with the sales end. I don't think their departments are linked up very effectiveley as we wanted to speak to someone about bespoke needs but kept being turned around to the website for answers. I ended up receiving about 3 different quote costs for the same  requirement. The best being from using the 'chatbot' system where a very helpful person gave us a much better price, which I paid; only to be chased up by other colleagues to see if I still wanted to follow up on their quotes (all had different numbers even though we were the same people asking for the same table top!)

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Worktop Express provide great worktops…
review: Worktop Express provide great worktops , sadly one of ours had the plastic protection broken and the best / top side was damaged and our fitter will need to rework the surface .

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Worktop Express were great but delivery was torture.
review: Worktop Express were great but never turned up for my delivery slot and the phoned 4 hours later saying they were on their way, disappointed as they had a huge delivery window and I paid good money for the delivery to be sitting in the house all day.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Advertise everywhere '2 man delivery'…
review: Advertise everywhere '2 man delivery' but don't actually help you up a few stairs incase a worker gets injured so leave me with a 4 metre heavy worktop on my own. Whats these policies.... Next day delivery means the next available day not necessarily next day. Don't fall for advertising cons...Pricing very good...

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Delivery was excellent and the driver…
review: Delivery was excellent and the driver kept me informed and was very helpful. But the worktop is bowed from where I imagine it wasn’t stored flat. Because I had the workman booked in he fitted it but it isn’t as good at it should be.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Easy ordering process and helpful…
review: Easy ordering process and helpful staff. Hoped that the wooden worktops would be better than Howdens but just on a par. Ordered 4 lengths, 2 good other 2 cupped. I guess this just has to be accepted when buying wood unless spending a fortune. Slightly more annoying were the voids when worktops were cut to size, factory edges were very good however.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Quality poor, delivery good
review: The ordering and delivery of my worktops was done very well. The quality of the worktop was below my expectations. For a start one worktop was thicker than the other by a couple of mm. Not great when you try and join them together and I don’t understand why I thought it was all done on CNC machines. Finally there was evidence of filler which doesn’t really match well with the wood

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Second but last time using.
review: Second time using.No complaints about the first. Quality and service was good.Second time, quality was poor. 2 x 3m lengths of oak block worktop failed due to poor adhesion of the blocks. Expert advice determined that the glue had failed.Hoops had to be jumped through many times to receive any compensation and the compensation offered was laughable given the amount already spent with the company. Sadly,  won't return again.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Double check loose trim is included
review: Unlike all of my previous orders this worktop didn’t come with loose end trim to finish so disappointed at having to order separately….and out of stock!*****In response to your reply if you are cutting down a 900mm x 3m breakfast bar…..as most people have too an end strip is essential, very disappointed plus you have none in stock or a restock date.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Great delivery times and worktop
review: The worktop received was very good and both the website and customer service experience was excellent.Delivery was on time and well communicated, but the drivers refused to walk 20 metres to the front door claiming it was "too far" and asked I refuse the delivery on their behalf. I had to scramble and get someone to help get it from the van to the house and I was fortunate enough to manage to get them in with a friend. Complete let down on the delivery side!

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: The oak rustic wood worktop we bought…
review: The oak rustic wood worktop we bought was severely bowed. Unfortunately the carpenter didn't realise it was bowed until he had already cut it so we can't send it back but we are left with a bowed worktop and so very disappointed with the purchase. Please don't send bowed wood to customers in future!!!

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Don’t buy pre stained …
review: Brought the black stained solid wood worktops, very rough finish and sharp edges, the stain had gloss parts on the edges. Had to give them a sand so completely wasted money getting them pre stained. Buy unstained and do it yourself. 900mm worktops were cupped and wouldn’t pull flat, had to mill them flat with a router. Gave 2 stars because the delivery service was very good but I would have gave 1

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: No problem using the web site but!!
review: No problem using the web site or making an order also customer service via email was good. However delivery wasn't great.  The worktops will only be delivered to ground floor but in live on the 6th floor of an apartment block with a lift but the delivery men still help me. I am in my mid 60s and had to get help as they were leaving the worktops in the foyer.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Customer service leaves alot to be…
review: Customer service leaves alot to be desired.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Ordered and paid for an ash worktop for…
review: Ordered and paid for an ash worktop for next day delivery only to  receive an e-mail later saying it was out of stock.  Telephoned to discuss and was told the person dealing with it would phone me back - they didn’t. Phoned again at 4:50 and was waiting for the person dealing with it to be free when, at 5:00, the phone was put down on me.  I suspect it was going home time.  Wouldn’t use your company again.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Worktop looks lovely
review: Worktop looks lovely. But when the worktop was being delivered the delivery team damaged the wall in my new cloakroom that had just been clad in interlocking pvc  panelling. This will be a nightmare and expensive to put right they didn’t even admit to what they had done. Waiting for a reply from them.Will not be letting them in my property again.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Colour looks nothing like the images on…
review: Colour looks nothing like the images on the site. Worktop was dropped by one of the delivers as he unfortunately tripped on a step, caused chip on corner which I only noticed after they had left. Stuck with them now and got to go through a lengthy staining process to get colour right

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: Damaged oak worktop…
review: Unfortunately the 3 meter oak worktop had bad damage to both of the long edges, we were able to resolve this by having both edges trimmed but it was not what we expected!However Worktop Express responded to the problem and issued a goodwill discount!

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: The product looks great but delivery…
review: The product looks great but delivery was not good. If you order any 4metre sections make sure you've got easy access for it. This was tricky for us and the delivery team took one look and left the worktops outdoors. They didn't seem interested in trying alternatives.

description: The UK's leading online worktop specialist, offering unbeatable value and unmistakable quality.
title: UNHAPPY CUSTOMER
review: Number 1. Part of the order was cut wrong.  Telephone customer services, she thought I was mistaken! Sent photographs and had no reply from the first contactThe following day a lovely ladle scaled Erika called and I explained everything. She sent a replacement.Number 2. The replacement was cut wrong again. All measurements were correct just cut INCORRECTLY. Lovely Erika tried to sort it out for us again.  Number 3. A replacement piece of worktop arrived.  Correctly cut but the shade was different to the first order.Explained all this to Erika and said we could not wait any longer to get this sorted.  She actually got us £105.00 compensation.  We accepted this as we could not deal with yet another episode from WorkTop Express.
