All the wood has to be cut to size, the doors have to be made from scratch and the metal poles have to have the holes drilled in them. Your instruction book (which we were told was out of date) said one thing and the video another. Neither showed clear instructions for a large tunnel, only a small one. I think for the price, the doors and boarding should all be cut to the specific size that is ordered. I had a very experienced builder helping but he'd never built a tunnel before. He was completely confused by the conflicting advice you gave. Luckily, he was good enough to just build it as he thought you meant. It's turned out fine but I wouldn't buy another one.

title: Polyethene
review: Very quick delivery and customer service is very good. Polyethene is ok, but in my honest opinion, not good quality. When you stretch it you leave hand marks that don't look attractive on completion. You will need to handle it like it's a prized possession or it will leave small holes. I understand it isn't normal polyethene but for the price, I thought it would be much better quality and stronger.

title: Disappointing long term
review: After just two years, the hotspot tape had disintegrated into powder and the first damage began to the cover. I sent an envelope full of the useless tape along with a letter explaining my concerns as well as follow up emails. I heard nothing and gave up chasing them. It's now December 2013 and the cover has more repair tape than should ever be necessary. Depending on how it survives this winter it may well have to be replaced. IT CERTAINLY WON'T BE WITH THIS COMPANY. The cover was fine but the hot spot tape degraded faster than ice cream on a beach and every hoop suffered some damage to the cover with the ends taking the brunt. I hadn't realised that I'd left a review, nor that I could update it. My long term experience has been much less satisfying than my local supplier offered with the previous cover and I will pay the bit extra next time for reliable products and customer service. That initial saving was simply not worth it in the long run. Lots of communication throughout the purchase and delivery. Plus full instructions and a packet of tomato seeds. (tomatoes are a weed in my tunnel alongside salad crops, but hey!, it's a nice freebie).Sadly, because I prefer to shop locally wherever possible, I paid £100 less for a superior product from 1st Tunnels than my local supplier.That's great for my limited pocket, but regrettable for our local economy.

title: Excellent Cabin - Customer Service/after sales not as good as expected
review: Firstly, I can't fault the cabin!  Absolutely excellent quality and worth the investment.  As a family with younger children, we have been making full use of the extra space especially during lockdown. The quality of workmanship and speed at which it was installed was incredible.I'm really sad to say though that the customer service side fell below my expectation :(I had read all about Arctic Cabins and reviews about their excellent customer service, this was unfortunately not my experience and I just felt like a number at times, with no after sales follow up to check we were happy (we were overall, but it would have been great customer service to confirm!).These cabins are not cheap for most people and it was an investment for us, yet I had to lead the email exchanges/calls requesting any additional information as there was no proactive approach from AC other than confirmation of the install date.  I would have loved to hear about the additional options available for the cabin such as tall sparks guards and table tops etc - I found out about these on forums - as a family with young children it would have been great if AC had suggested the tall sparks guard for increased safety, the children were with us when we visited the show room.The guys who installed the cabin were great, helpful and friendly - a word to the wise in that you will need to keep a look out for roofing tacks/nails around the cabin, I collected around 20 or so amongst the grass once they had left. Overall would definitely recommend the cabins but customer service missing the personal touch during our experience.

title: This is a beautiful cabin and I would…

title: The Cabin is fantastic but keep the fire small
review: The Cabin is fantastic, as was the service when we ordered it and had it installed. The reason for 3 stars rather than 5 is because i was burning wood for a number of hours and apparently overheated the chimney. Luckily i noticed this immediately as the paint on the chimney ignited all the way round and the flames were quickly creeping up the outside of the chimney towards the timber roof.  i was fortunate to have a hosepipe nearby which i used to quickly extinguish the burning paint. I guess i am to blame for having overheated the chimney but there is no thermometer on the chimney to warn of overheating and i don't recall seeing any warning that fires must be kept small or the paint could catch fire. We were told that as we had used the BBQ as a bonfire the warranty won't cover it.  I am still pleased with the cabin overall but really quite sad to have damaged it without meaning to and to have been told we had used it as a bonfire which sounds very irresponsible, thus voiding the warranty.

title: poor aftersales service
review: Whilst the product and the installation service is good they appear to lose interest after thay have your money. We bought a 10m hut via a display at a county show. As we knew we would be moving house in a couple of years we asked about taking the hut with us. The salesman informed us that Arctic Cabins offered a relocation service. Fixed fee all in. That was the deal clincher. Should have been more sceptical. Come moving time, they don't answer emails, promises of return phone calls don't happen. Had to write to the owner direct to get a response. They now no longer offer a relocation service despite other staff members saying that relocation services were only on hold. So their promises are hollow and does not give any confidence in their after sales service or worth to the 10 year warranty. This is my experience only, others may say differently. Just be aware.Update after the response below:-Thank you for your response.A few corrections to your statements.Firstly: In my telephone conversations, (you never replied to emails except the one from Gareth) I fully understood that you were busy, all I did was make a suggestion as a way round the situation if you ever had teams in the area. These were not demands as you infer but a suggested way round it.Secondly: I did not offer to pay £700 for the move with everything thrown in. As I stated in my letter to Gareth this was the all in fixed price quoted by your sales representative so kindly stop trying to twist things round.Thirdly: You state above that you still offer a relocation service. Perhaps you should clear that statement with Gareth, your owner, who stated categorically and for the avoidance of any doubt that your company no longer offers a relocation service.I have never indicated any doubt as to the extremely hard work and difficulties your teams and experiencing. As I said in my letter we were very pleased with the ways things happened from order taking to installation. After sales service is all part of the package and equally important as part of the  relationship, hence the deduction of two stars.For the poor way in which you have replied to this review I have deducted another star.Stars can be awarded or removed. They could also be reinstated. To all those reading this review of my experience, as I said above; 'Be aware'

title: This is a difficult review to write...
review: This is a difficult review to write. We have access issues to the lounge and therefore couldnt buy a £699 SCS (not as we would anyway!) special off the peg thing, as it wouldnt fit through the door from the hall to the lounge.This was the reason we ended up at a bespoke manufacturer, and everything was handled well on the ordering and selection of the sofa and cuddle seat for the bay was easy and trouble free. Dimensions of the (lack of) access and photos had duly been emailed up.So, as specified the furniture turns up as organised first drop. In come the smaller items, then the longest piece, which wont fit through the door.Turned it round, took feet off, still no go. I have a delivery driver with his head in his hands at this point in my hall 8am in the morning.phone calls start and the question is asked, "will the bay window come out?" Obviously it will, but this is not what is planned.As luck would have it, we have a window guy coming over that day to measure up for new windows, that soon changes to "How soon can you take the bay window out, Graham?" Graham(5 stars) rearranges and we do have a sofa in the house by lunchtime which we do like.This is where I have mixed emotions, We do like whats come and are happy with it, but, if we were not having new windows the bay would NOT of come out, that is not what was agreed.The light fitting took a battering in the hall trying to get the sofa in, its badly damaged and wants replacing.Also, a call to see if the sofa was in the house would not of gone amiss, it could still be on our drive waiting to go in for all J&R know.I am all for the small businessman, I am one, reviews are important to us all these days so hate being critical unless its constructive. Bad news can travel fast. The sofa is a 5 star but the experience (that the rating asks) for is a 3 I am afraid, It left us a little cold.

title: Excellent Fence Products but Post-Crete Problems....
review: I ordered 6'x6' extra-heavy duty fence panels, gravel boards, posts and post-crete from East Coast Fencing a couple of weeks ago.  My order arrived as scheduled and the driver was extremely helpful and friendly.  The panels are well built and quite substantial.  The posts and gravel boards are as expected.  Now that I have started installing the fence panels, I have discovered that about 1/3 of the post-crete bags have solidified in one form or another.  Some bags have a large lump of solid concrete at the bottom, other bags have solidified almost completely.  As this is not my first fence rodeo, I did cover the bags with a tarp in hopes of avoiding such an issue.  I am now stuck with a number of slabs of solid concrete which I will have to dispose of by paying the fee at the local recycling centre and will have to buy additional post-crete to replace what has been lost.  I will also have to pick up, load myself in order to avoid silly delivery charges for relatively few bags.  Very disappointing.

title: While the website worked well...

Along comes Friday and while I'm working from home, I keep an eye out on CCTV and check the tracking on the website which says "7am-1pm". After 1pm, I check the tracking again and it says "Completed/delivered"... I'm about to call up when I decide to go outside and just check I didn't miss it, and there we have 8 posts sitting on the driveway beside the car.I had no doorbell ring, phone call, email, sms to say they were coming or it had been delivered, so I check back on CCTV and there's nothing until 4am where a flatbed van pulls up and dumps it on the driveway. I can only assume it was to avoid paying the toll for crossing from Essex...?The only other point marking it down is the now constant 'timed' sale across the website. This happened the day after I bought the posts, which was annoying.

title: Excellent quality
review: The quality of the fencing is 5*. It is superb. I’ve given 4* due to the poor delivery information. To be told ‘it will arrive some time the week commencing’ is totally understandable when the order is first placed, but to still not know exactly which day until the day before is very frustrating. Still no info by Tuesday of the delivery week. I called them & got ‘Yes, it’s still going to be delivered this week. If you haven’t heard yet it means it won’t be tomorrow (Wednesday), so either Thursday or Friday.’ Not all of us work from home & are also not able to reschedule our days at the drop of a hat. Also not all of us have loads of space to store fencing. It’s all very well saying don’t book your tradesman until it’s been delivered but tradesmen are busy & need advance booking. A very frustrating process. The delivery driver was very pleasant & efficient. Please consider keeping your customers more informed.

I've decided that I will keep it because it's a jug, and it's kind of OK for my purposes. It's a beloved set which my British mother working in South Africa in 1949 received from her family in Bournemouth when she married my father. Bizarrely, she never liked it! But I loved it, and she later gave it to me. I brought it back to the UK when I came here 2002. I'm OK with a jug which doesn't quite match. I just don't have the time to look any more.

You could sneeze at it and it will fall off... together with the shrinking doors they need refitting to get them to line up again .Now, I am not the tallest man around.... but who thought the idea of manufacturing a shed with only a door height of 5'4" was a good idea.... title: Very Good easy post repair system

I got one of the post buddys in the front of the post and one to the side, both hammered down to the "OK marker" - got a really good fixing with the recommended  screws, but the post does still move about 75mm at the top of the post - personally I think more metal post buddy should be out the ground to stop any movement on the existing broken post. I also think that the broken post could do with one more post buddy to the rear, but they only come in pairs (i think).

The family business based in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, first began in the Phelans’ back garden when a broken fence post caused their fence to lean. Wayne did not relish the thought of digging out and replacing the damaged fence post. He knew that existing products on the market made for back-breaking, time-consuming work. Looking for a quicker, easier solution, Wayne, a former Development Project Manager, came up with new ideas on how to fix a leaning fence.……..and Post Buddy was born.

Both Wayne and Gaby committed themselves to their new business venture and Gaby uses her experience as a PA to ensure Fence-Aid’s customers receive top quality service. Together Gaby and Wayne continue to grow and develop the company.

title: Shame, really...
review: Whilst the 'product' (2 x flat pieces of stabilising metal drilled with screw holes) is nicely made, well-packaged and delivered on time as per the promises, I'm afraid the Post Buddy system didn't work for me.  It relies on the post stub below ground remaining physically intact, with no rot and thus capable of providing the resistance necessary to keep the upper part of the post stable.  Whilst wooden posts do indeed rot at the point they meet earth, the assumption that the stub beneath retains structural integrity isn't always correct - my post was incased in concrete but still the stub had rotted and hence, couldn't support the forces necessary to keep the Post Buddy metal strips stable.  The post is at least less able to tilt and/or fall, but regrettably a new post and all the heartache of digging out the old stub/concrete and reaffixing the new one will still be needed mid- to long-term.

review: Ordering the product was easy and someone got in touch with me when I realised a complaint. This is the only reason I gave 2 stars. The shed we purchased was an absolute extortion for the poor quality. I was not informed when the shed would be delivered as promised in my order receipt. This meant this massive package was delivered to a neighbour that I didn't know to much inconvenience to them. We then had to carry the thing across to our house which was also difficult. I complained and there was nothing but an apology for this error. Can't say I'm impressed with their complaints policy. No compensation. The shed should be discontinued or sold for half the price. Absolute waste of money. Takes about 6 people to build it, poor instructions and parts not labelled clearly at all.

title: Disappointed for price point.

Lastly, several pieces of the wood were cracked on arrival, I'm not expecting every piece to be perfect condition regardless of delivery obviously, but this was seemingly caused by wood rot and not a overly zealous delivery man.Overall, I expected better quality wood, the windows are too small to fit the shed properly & parts of the delivery being unprotected on arrival was disappointing.Will just use my local shed company next time.

The delivery date was set, however the parcelforce driver did not deliver albeit only 2 roads away at the beginning of allocated time slot. Customer service effectively lied to us and said they had no details of why the parcel was not delivered, the driver gave no explanation and when we raised a complaint parcelforce sent a blank reply just saying your parcel has been delivered. When I followed up and said I assume this is a mistake they replied and said take it up with the company you placed the order with.If you want to keep your reputation I would suggested upgrading to a reliable delivery service such as DPD.However product ordered on Sunday and delivered on Wednesday. Thanks Go Electrical sorry for the downgrade on the score but a partner of your business is considered an extension of your business and their actions will impact your reputation:/

I imagine he was frustrated because he had to wait, if they had called as requested perhaps he would have been more helpful. Other than that all good!

review: 2nd year buying here. Excellent quality tree again, lasts a long time, holds out for the whole month of December, excellent needle retention. Will definitely buy again next year!

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄

review: Recently took delivery of 2 beautiful trees. A Fraser fir and a Sussex fir. Without a doubt the best trees I’ve had for many years. Delivery was as requested and when I needed to change my delivery date, Lucy was incredibly helpful. Won’t be getting my trees from anywhere else in the future.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: This was my first time ordering a tree…
review: This was my first time ordering a tree online. There was an initial hiccup when my delivery date was delayed, but I was impressed with the professional way that Bethan and Lucy assisted to make sure that the tree was delivered the next day in time for a special event. The tree itself is absolutely beautiful- it is a perfect shape with healthy looking and full foliage, and it smells divine. It arrived very well packed and in good condition. Thanks again to the whole team!

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: SUPER impressed
review: SUPER impressed. I've struggled for a couple of years to find a company that sends quality high-end Christmas trees that look like a perfect tree. This is the first year I've used Send Me A Christmas Tree. The tree arrived on the date I picked (with clear communication regarding shipping and arrival dates). The tree itself has clearly only just been cut (it's drinking water like it's going out of fashion) and hadn't been wrapped in a package too long as the branches fell into position quickly. I highly recommend this company.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄

review: Beautiful trees great shape and delivered to the door - takes all the hassle out of shopping for Christmas trees (if you are fussy like my husband and need it to be UK grown and Norway spruce!) Will be putting in my order for next year for sure.

review: This is the first year I’ve used this company and I’m absolutely delighted with the magnificent 5ft Fraser Fir they sent. It’s by far the best tree I’ve ever had, and it’s been much admired. The only thing stopping me from giving five stars is their delivery service provision - the comms from their provider were poor and it would be better if they could guarantee a delivery date. This said, I’ll be ordering from Send Me A Christmas Tree again next year!

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄

I'd advise using less plastic wrap on the trees, too!We are using this company again and we can't wait to receive our tree on 30th November!

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄

The only thing that I would have liked was tracking for the tree so that I knew it was delayed but on the way. That is the only reason I have taken a star off but we have ordered another one for the year and hopefully all will go well so I can do a five star review next year!

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄

It did drop its needles a bit even though we had it in water but that’s part of the Christmas joy, and our main requirement was that it was narrow.I have come back to buy another this year.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Beautiful tree, lasted well, helpful service
review: Bought a Fraser Fir off these guys last year. They delivered bang on time, the tree was in great condition and they were very helpful with some questions i had early on. The tree lasted really well and looked beautiful, it was exactly what I wanted. It was so nice to have a selection of different, some unusual, trees to choose from. And if you're not sure what you want - their website quiz really does help throw up good options (oh and I also do recommend a Fraser Fir!)

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: I ordered a tree from this company last…
review: I ordered a tree from this company last year. Promt delivery. Very nice tree and the needles stayed on. Just ordered one for this year. The only reason I have 4 stars is the tree was a bit muddy when it arrived I had to take it out to the garden and hose it off. But a very nice tree

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Beautiful Tree and excellent service!
review: Purchased our pot grown tree from this company last year for the first time.  Delivered on time and smelled wonderful, also well packaged.  The tree was a lovely shape and perfect size but we did have a small issue with needledrop.  I contacted the company and they could not have been more helpful - there was no hesitation in advising me to wait until the tree had "acclimatised" indoors, but if the problem persisted then go back to them.  The problem solved itself within a couple of days and our tree was lovely.  Have ordered again this year for the sheer convenience and a really competitive price.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Very easy straight forward order…
review: Very easy straight forward order process, only issue was that there were flies dead and alive in the tree..managed to resolve that and tree is now out in the garden ready for next year :)

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Ok small tree but had to re-pot
review: Unfortunately the experience was let down by the fact that the pot the tree was send in was too small to be usable, it had roots breaking out through cracks in the pot, and the tree had been potted at such a sloppy lopsided angle the tree could barely stay upright and would have been hard to decorate without toppling.Re-potted neatly into an appropriately sized pot it's decent looking little tree (emphasis on the little, I ordered a tree of size 150-180cm and the one I received just barely hits that minimum), but it is lucky I had a suitable pot and soil available.A little more care would go a long way in turning this into a smooth customer experience instead of having to work to make the tree usable.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Have been ordering my tree from them…
review: Have been ordering my tree from them for the last five/ six years issues with delivery which to be fair was sorted quite quickly so disappointed with my tree this year supposed to be same size as I always order no where near as tall and so skinny really disappointed think I will go else where next year

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Disappointing, such a shame
review: This was my first time ordering a tree online, and I’ve been left really disappointed. Ordered a pot grown Nordman Fir, the delivery went well, though there were a number of branches broken in transit. The most disappointing thing is that a number of other branches are missing, leaving just the stump at the end of each branch which is really obvious. I shared some images with the company and whilst they replied quickly, they’ve said it’s just down to pruning the tree and they hope I can “decorate it and enjoy it” which came across fairly patronising! Would really caution ordering a tree from this company, otherwise you may end up with one that has been abruptly and obviously pruned. I’ve definitely learnt my lesson and will go back to choosing a tree in person to ensure it’s quality and worth the price.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: 5 star service, 1 star tree
review: This is our second time ordering from Send Me a Christmas Tree and unfortunately this experience did not live up to the last. Positives - amazing service. The website is informative, the ordering process is seamless, great communication post-order and pre-delivery, delivery was right on time and completely painless.Negatives - the tree. We ordered the same type of tree as last year (Korean fir) because it was such an awesome tree. The tree that arrived this year is, by all measures, pretty lacklustre. I don't know if we previously just had an exceptional tree, if growing conditions weren't ideal this year, or if we received the tail end of the stock - whatever the case, this tree just isn't great. It's sparse, frail and although the correct size, just looks a bit stunted. We've let it settle for a couple of days and will probably give it another day or two before decorating, but it still is a pretty sad sight. Definitely not the tree we were expecting.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Not very happy
review: I ordered an 80-100cm potted tree and it has just arrived. It’s the perfect size however, has lost a couple of big-ish branches. It arrived on time and was packaged well, however, the pot has broken and now there is mud everywhere. For the price I paid, I would’ve hoped for a pot that wasn’t too small for the tree upon arrival and that it was in one piece. Not very happy and probably won’t be buying from here again due to the price you pay for what you get. Now off to fork out for a pot that’s actually the right size.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Happy in previous years, but unhappy in 2022
review: Whilst we have used sendmeachristmastree.co.uk in previous years and been quite happy with our tree, we were disappointed this year. The tree spent at least 3 days in transit/being sent in and out of the delivery depot, and did not arrive on the selected delivery date two or three days in a row. I understand that the delivery date is not always definite, but I received texts from the deliverer each day saying the tree would arrive that day and it did not. The team was helpful when I communicated with them, saying that the tree was still on its way. However, the tree arrived reddish-brown: both the trunk and the branches looked unwell since the day it arrived, and was losing needles at an incredible pace. I was worried there would be no needles by Christmas Day. We disposed of the tree on 26 December because it was so unwell, when we normally keep the tree up until 6 Jan. Even as of yesterday, 10 January, I am seeing trees thrown out on the street that look healthier now than our tree did the day that it was delivered to us.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Beautiful healthy long-lasting and beautiful trees - with poor delivery service
review: Their trees are lovely - great shape and last well for a month.  However, they use Tuffnell's delivery service who really let both the company and their customers down.  This year they delivered a tree to my neighbour and lost mine on the same day. Three days later, I'm still waiting to hear when or if it will arrive. Delivery was chaotic the past two years too.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Nordman fir tree arrived on day booked
review: Nordman fir tree arrived on day booked. Well wrapped in Clingfilm.  Put straight into water and left outside till today. (4 days later). When unwrapped three large branches broken at trunk leaving a hole one side.  Had to rotate 360 degrees to find an acceptable “front”.  Would not have been a tree I would have selected but will do the job.Further to reply from Company, cannot send photos, tree in place, fully decorated and damaged side in corner out of view....

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Second time I have received a poor tree
review: Second time I have ordered from them and second time I’ve been disappointed. Tree is very dry and needles already dropping as soon as you touch itContacted them today received no reply. Last time ordered half dead tree sent and had to wait for a replacement.Will not be ordering a third time that’s for sure.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: I’m STILL waiting for my tree
review: I’m STILL waiting for my tree!  I used this company last year and was really impressed. This year has just been appalling due to Tuffnells delivery service. They lost the first tree and were due to deliver a replacement today.  Needless to say it hasn’t arrived. If and when it comes I only hope it’s a nice tree.The tree arrived and it is lovely. The tree company has refunded some of the cost which is great. The experience of Tuffnells puts me off using them again.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Great delivery service
review: Great delivery service, and good quality tree. Although it’s not what I was expecting. I ordered an 8ft blue spruce and going by the gallery you have on your website, in particular ‘Leon’s blue spruce’ my tree seems quite slim and well... quite sparse compared. A little disappointed but I do like the tree, just not what I had expected.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: This tree sums up 2020 - crap!
review: Update 18/12 **** Have received a replacement tree which is a much better shape and quality.  Have given an extra star for service. *****This tree sums up 2020! It is not a tree I would have chosen and certainly not value for money. The tree is twisted and misshapen with holes where branches have broken off or been too close to another tree. It has a double top, a lot of the lower branches are brown. Very disappointed considering the reviews that have been left. I will not but from them again and could not recommend anyone else to do so. The delivery service was fine but the tree.......

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: ordered a 16 foot tree
review: ordered a 16 foot tree and was assured it would be delivered to the door but driver of the van dropped it at the end of the drive. Had to hire a couple of lads to move it. Company said they will have a word with the driver as it should not have happened

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: 6ft Nordman Fir
review: Ordered a 6ft Nordman Fir for Xmas 2020 it arrived exactly on the date picked. Beautiful tree that stayed looking great the whole time up . can highly recommend. Now looking forward to this year's tree which I have just ordered.Cheers JamesSo update review regarding 2021 tree.Tree hasn't arrived so far shipped apparently on the 02/12 for 03/12 delivery . Received email to advise of shipping issue with no details.Since then I have sent 4 emails for a ETA and tracking number request with no response... I have also tried the online and WhatsApp messenger again nothing.More disappointing is they have time to respond to good reviews here within hours of posting.Overall disappointed .Finally got through on the phone today and have been offered a replacement tree which I have accepted .I will update on arrival.Due 10/12

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Disappointing
review: I ordered from sendmeachristmastree because they are (relatively) local but mainly because they minimize time between cutting and delivery. Positive points: delivery as expected, lovely scentNegative points: Cut so close to bottom branches, it could not fit in a container without removing lower branches which completely ruined the shape. Took about 4 days to recover from extremely tight wrapping, many peripheral branches too weak to support decorations, started to shed about the same time as trees bought previously - about 10 days (in spite of maintaining water in reservoir) and biggest negative of all.. more than double the price of trees available locally. Final sting in the tail.. on seeing tree collection service, I thought that was good - until when you go to book it costs £10.00...So, sadly won’t be buying from them again.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: CS experience 5, Tree 3. It’s the tree I’m rating though
review: Customer service were very pleasant on first contact. I had entered wrong post code and they called to ensure it was corrected. Very nice lady on the phone. Tree arrived during the day specified which was great. However this is the reason I have only given three stars. The tree we received is bent. It’s like the leaning tower of Pisa and is completely off centre. I appreciate these are never perfectly straight, as I have had many a Christmas tree, although I would expect many people would be slightly aggrieved by it. As a consequence, and because of the bend, it won’t slide all the way down my tree stand. Only barely sits in the water bowl which is a good 5-6 inches deep (use every year for similar sized trees). Aside from the the tree looks healthy and full-some. So I can see why many people rate this company 5*. I would certainly use the company again but learn from this order to try and perhaps make a request for a better quality check their end prior to delivery.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Pricing is great but.....
review: Pricing is great, delivered as promise but need to work on couriers to ensure delivery is to correct address as requested

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Hugely disappointed loyal customer
review: I have been a loyal customer for 5 years and in the past, the trees have been the best I had. This year’s tree is a huge disappointment. I ordered a 7ft Nordmann Fir the same as the previous five years but the tree does not remotely compare. It is about 2/3rds of the size of like for like orders of previous years for the same price. It is very asymmetric, skinny, spindly with lots of bare trunk and bears no resemblance to the trees shown on the online videos. You certainly wouldn’t pick the tree out. It is drastically overpriced compared to what I have seen a garden centres this year.  I only wish that I could upload photos so you could see how drastically the quality has dropped from last year. Perhaps it is because Send Me A Christmas Trees have had a few article write-ups this year that there isn’t enough good stock to satisfy demand. I have offered a three star review based on the fact that previously the trees were beautiful. If I had to rate this year’s tree, a 2 would be generous. I have recommended this company to so many friends and family based on their compliments of previous years. I am now off to find a replacement tree and next year will pick a tree by eye.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Dead Christmas tree
review: Hi,I have seen the reviews on here regarding send me a Christmas tree,Sorry this review isn't good ,I recieved my tree on the 29th November, I done the usual, cut about 3 inches off of the bottom placed it in water ,about a week later I noticed the branches starting to droop,and needles falling off .about another week later the tree looks dead and is an embarrassing if anyone comes around ,you can't touch the tree otherwise wherever you touch the needles fall off, this has got to be the worst tree that I have ever had.I have contacted send me a Christmas tree and they replied very quickly,asking me to send them some photos and that they would try and resolve this problem very quickly and that they would get in touch with me in up to 24hours ,well its been over 48 hours and I haven't heard anything .looks like that I've got to go out and spend another £60/70 for another tree, this is not good enough.Since writing this review send me a Christmas tree have been in touch approx 15mins after writing ,offering me a full refund with an explanation of what may have happened ,HEAT SHOCK .which happens to 1 tree in a 100 (trust me to have that one .I'm no tree expert so thanks to send me a Christmas for their service so going out now to try a get a decent tree for XmasI hope everyone who reads this has a very happy Xmas and stay safe get your vaccinations my tree didn't and look what happened to that

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Don’t trust delivery day
review: I’d ordered my trees very early - in October in fact - as I like to have one very large one and a smaller one and it was a cost effective way to do that. When I ordered I picked a Friday delivery, knowing that it wasn’t guaranteed but with there also being an option for Saturday, I figured my children would have a great weekend decorating the tree. A few days before the delivery I’d had the option to cancel the order as the tree I had wanted wasn’t up to the quality standard, but I chose a different type and went along with it and received an email saying my trees had been despatched. Come Friday, I had an email from the courier saying the trees were on the van and I could expect them that day. At 5pm, there was nothing so I called sendmeatree to find out where it was. They said I should expect it until 6pm, or later. Around 9pm the status on the delivery website was updated to delivered - with still no sign of the trees. They eventually got to me on Monday, though with no information from the courier until late morning, with the larger tree (a Norway Spruce) not having its middle spike and therefore nowhere for a star or anything. I was disappointed having not being told that Saturday deliveries were no longer available (that decision was known in November but not communicated to people who had ordered before) so delays went to the following week. The larger tree wasn’t perfect and the smaller tree was already a substitute. Although this was mainly the delivery company’s fault and the tree people did try to chase them up, all in all it wasn’t great service. Perhaps Friday deliveries should not be available if the trees are going to roll around in the truck for the weekend and be delivered like that. I didn’t have the energy after all the hassle to send it back.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Tree not delivered yesterday (weather…
review: Tree not delivered yesterday (weather was fine on day delivery should have happened). Company phoned saying they do not deliver at weekends so delivery will not be until Monday (providing they actually deliver then). Tree will have been without any water for at least 3 days and probably longer so will not be in great condition.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Never again. Late, poor quality dried out tree.
review: This is our third year and will definitely be our last. Our delivery day was a little later than we had hoped, but was delayed a second time. The tree itself has been a big disappointment, with huge needle drop and no matter what we try no water uptake. The tree was very lightweight when delivered, indicating it was already dried out, and after less than a week is not presentable. Really disappointing for the premium price paid. Complained to customer services and just get a a somewhat patronising response. Very poor service and I honestly feel robbed.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Dry tree. But customer service was good.
review: They seem to be cutting their trees too early this year. I have bought my Christmas tree from them for the past several years. In previous years, they were perfectly wrapped and still damp to keep it fresh. You could tell from the cut that it was freshly cut. HOWEVER, this year is completely opposite. The new delivery company (their previous delivery co went into administration) held my tree for 5 days, saying they were waiting for appointed date. The tree arrived poorly wrapped, completely dry and it shed an extreme amount of needles immediately. It is only 6 days and my tree is yellowish brown on the ends and the needles fall at a slight touch. It's depressing.  The tree won't last till Christmas.UPDATE: Customer service has been great. I was offered either another tree or a partial refund. I'll have to wait until next Christmas to find out if this is just a one-off bad tree. I'll update again next Christmas.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Great service but tree quality poor
review: Service great, tree delivered on time and well wrapped. Beautiful tree, but Most of the end of the branches are snapped, we removed 2 shopping bags of needles from the floor and the lower tree branches are so floppy that It makes it hard to hand anything from the lower branches. There is no way this tree was cut the day before it was dispatched.We ordered as we are waiting for our new car delivery and we couldn’t fit a large tree in our mini. I wouldn’t use again, this is very expensive for a tree that will probably not last until the new year. Disappointed to say the least.Update 14/12: full refund was given following communication with the owner. It was good to see a very professional response and customer feedback being taken into account, usually the sign of a good business. Thank you

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Disappointed
review: I used this company last year and got a Sussex Fir - nice tree and no problems. So I decided to use the same company this year but wanted a tree that reminded me of my youth -  strong smell and branches - so ordered a Norway Spruce. Delivery was one day late which was annoying given that I had taken the day off of work - the tree went out for delivery but apparently the driver ran out of hours so it went back to the depot. Anyway, when the tree finally arrived it had a couple of  branches that had needles that were totally brown. It doesn't smell at all, and most of the branches are so flimsy I cannot hang baubles on them. Also, I have never had needles drop from a tree at the rate this one does - it is in a stand supplied by the company and full of water but does not appear to drink at all. I'm hoping it will last until Christmas, but not at all confident. Given the delivery fiasco, though, I don't want to go through the process of getting a replacement so will treat this as a harsh lesson learned for next year.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: A disappointing experience
review: This was our first experience of a real Christmas tree and we were too slow reacting to concerns about continuing needle droppage and lack of water intake, which resulted in the tree beginning to cease to be presentable 13 days after delivery.A replacement tree purchased locally for the same cost (and we understand that had been similarly shipped south from Scotland) looks and feels to the touch so much fresher and healthier. With this comparison and the issues we had, we suspect the tree was delivered in a less than fresh state and drying out. It might well have responded to appropriate intervention if we had contacted the company for suitable advice earlier.Unfortunately, the company has chosen in our case to strictly enforce their 4 day window for raising concerns or requesting refunds. We feel that doing this instead of taking responsibility that a tree advertised as "cut fresh" was delivered in this condition to begin with is disappointing.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Poor customer service
review: This is our third year ordering with this company. Service and tree quality in 2020 was great. 2021, the tree was great however the wreath we ordered arrived almost 2 weeks after we expected it. This year (2022), the tree we received only lasted 12 days before we had to get rid of it and purchase a new one. The tree was a little sad upon arrival and we had our suspicions that it may not last the distance. Sure enough, after about a week it became  incredibly dry and droopy, despite watering it. We wrote to SMACT and they were completely unhelpful - basically saying they wouldn’t do anything as we had to highlight any issues within 4 working days of the trees arrival. This wasn’t really possible as the tree only really went downhill after this point. We were offered 10% off for next year but we turned it down as frankly we expected better service for the money we have paid. It’s a shame because we would have been happy with a simple apology and a partial refund. In short - we won’t be ordering from them again as there are many great Christmas tree suppliers available!Update in response to SMACT’s response. We highlighted this issue on the 13th, rather than the 14th. We did not receive any advice regarding prolonging the longevity of the tree - we were only asked whether we had watered the tree and yes, we had.  In any case any longevity advice would have been pointless as the tree was completely dead. I don’t think it’s unreasonable to expect a tree to last longer than 12 days. As we were unhappy with the initial reply, we requested a further response from a manager / owner however we were ignored. Not really sure why the difference between natural deterioration or a specific issue has to be pin pointed. The fact is that it was clear from the photos we sent that the deterioration started prior to the 13th - a  good quality fresh Christmas tree should last longer than 12 days before turning completely droopy, dry and brown. All in all, a very frustrating company to deal with who do not value repeat loyal customers, hide behind emails and refuse to put good (or even adequate) customer service or common sense to the forefront of their business model.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Pot grown tree arrived without a pot
review: Pot grown tree arrived without a pot, in a plastic sack showing open roots without further instructions. Very small tree -tree size was 120cm and with ‘pot’ included it measured just under 150cm (-paid for biggest option 150-175cm). Tree wrapped in enough plastic to cover England..talk about increasing the carbon footprint!Nice shape makes up for my overall dissapointment..

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: risky
review: Nice range of trees in all sizes, delivered to your door at a good price. Reordering this year. Recommend. Takes away the hassle of getting a tree in a hatchback.Edit: The above was last year's experience. This year, no tree has shown up for a second day running. If it ever comes, it will be after the weekend, so 5 days late. Been told by them that they get it right 9 times out of 10 (not exactly great), but my experience is a 50% fail rate. Wouldn't use again, couldn't recommend.

description: Fresh-cut, British grown Christmas trees - delivered straight to your door! 🎄
title: Bought a tree last year and it was…
review: Bought a tree last year and it was absolutely perfect so ordered one this year. I am really disappointed, there is no fulness to it, and it is not the correct "christmas tree" shape. The branches are very flimsy, all different lengths and growing in all different directions, some are even u shaped. An expensive mistake, one I wont be making again.

description: Contact Security Services provides professional security solutions for homes and businessess all over Scotland.
title: Extremely happy with the service…
review: Extremely happy with the service received from start to finish really professional & knowledgeable about what would be expected. I was kept up to date with everything. Very pleasant staff team.Really happy with the installation & alarm system. Great company highly recommended. No mess left & everything was explained clearly.

description: Contact Security Services provides professional security solutions for homes and businessess all over Scotland.
title: Really Slick and Professional company
review: Really Slick and professional company. We were looking to upgrade our old monitored alarm system and was recommended to call this company. I was impressed with the initial meeting as I was shown a live alarm system on an ipad and given  an instant quote which I considered highly competitive. We chose a comprehensive WIFI linked system with room sensors, Heat alarm, front door opening chime and external cameras which we can view on our phones.    The images and sound from the cameras is really impressive.  I have had the Alarm system over a year now and have never felt so comfortable leaving the house secure in the mind that Contact Security Services are keeping an eye on things.

review: I have been with this alarm company for many years and they are the best. The engineers are very knowledgeable and professional, they were so patient with helping me use my new alarm. The sales team and admin staff are so lovely and genuine. The whole team are all very passionate about security and safety.

Without any hesitation.

review: We had requested upgrade information to our home security system because it was still connected to the phone line which we wanted to disconnect from the house. The sales rep was very nice, explained the options and the details available which helped us make the right decision. We have selected the suitable upgrade option which was installed a few days later. The technician was a very nice guy, very knowledgeable. He walked us through the installation process, gave us a demo and answered all of our questions satisfactorily we had regarding the system. Everything went smoothly and all in all it was a great experience. Definitely recommending this company to everyone!

review: Love Contact,  service planned and executed great except that the engineer unplugged our outdoor lighting to plug their monitor in to check the cctv then didn’t plug it back in again so when we eventually noticed our lights weren’t working had to go into the loft to sort.

description: Contact Security Services provides professional security solutions for homes and businessess all over Scotland.
title: Generally good, with one exception
review: My experience of them over a period of several years now is that they are usually quite good and helpful when I've had to be in touch. There's one exception to that, which explains the 4 stars. The alarm fobs aren't very durable. One of mine broke after 2-3 years and I anticipated a replacement wouldn't be a problem. I was told you have to pay, even though I was into a new contract by then and hadn't received any new ones. I bought a replacement and same thing happened to it. They just don't last that long without breaking. I'd suggest using sturdier fobs or be willing to replace the little flat ones if/ when they break.

review: Gary always pleasant and competent.   He explained to us about using the app very well.  He had to come back a few days later as our conservatory door kept activating alarm however it was quickly rectified.
